news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9 million, up 18% year-over-year but about $1.8 million below the $12.7 million consensus estimate, with an adjusted loss per share of $0.38 versus the $0.29 expected; neurosurgery navigation and therapy revenue grew 62% to $5.6 million while biologics and drug delivery revenue fell 15% to $4.0 million. Cash fell to $29.4 million from $45.9 million at the start of the year, and shares dropped roughly 15-18% in after-hours trading to around $13, well off the 52-week high of $30.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Aug 2026 slides: $500m revenue target amid Q2 miss
news.summary: Alongside its disappointing Q2 print, ClearPoint Neuro unveiled an expanded five-pillar "Essential. Everywhere." strategy, adding a Commercial Drug Delivery pillar targeting $300 million in additional annual revenue on top of $200 million from its existing four pillars, for a combined long-term goal of $500 million. The plan envisions capacity for 5,000 cell and gene therapy procedures a year and co-labeled products with 10+ partners across eight indications, alongside lowered 2026 revenue guidance of $48-$52 million, down from the $52-$56 million range reiterated after Q1.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro's partner Aspen Neuroscience received FDA RMAT designation for sasineprocel (ANPD001), an investigational autologous dopaminergic cell replacement therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered using ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula in the ASPIRO trial. The designation grants Aspen Fast Track and Breakthrough Therapy-like benefits, including closer FDA interaction and potential eligibility for accelerated approval.

news.headline: BlackRock reports 7.1% stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: BlackRock disclosed an amended Schedule 13G filing showing a passive beneficial ownership stake of 7.1% in ClearPoint Neuro's common stock, reflecting institutional investor positioning ahead of the company's Q2 2026 earnings report.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results August 3, 2026
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro announced it would release second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close on Monday, August 3, 2026, followed by a conference call and webcast; the company also noted the ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) facility was now in its possession, with new services revenue expected to return the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to growth in Q3.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro stock surges on peer's FDA approval plan
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro shares surged roughly 50% after partner uniQure said the FDA agreed that 3-year Phase I/II data could support a Biologics License Application for accelerated approval of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, a therapy administered using ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow cannula. UniQure said it intends to submit the BLA in the third quarter of 2026.

catalysts.label: uniQure planned BLA submission for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease
catalysts.detail: Partner uniQure intends to submit a Biologics License Application for accelerated approval of AMT-130, which is delivered using ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow cannula; a positive outcome would be a strong proof point for ClearPoint's drug-delivery platform.

catalysts.label: Biologics and Drug Delivery segment expected to return to growth
catalysts.detail: Company guidance points to new services revenue from the now-operational ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) facility returning the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to sequential growth after a Q2 decline.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro's next quarterly results release, expected roughly three months after the August 3, 2026 Q2 report, based on the company's historical reporting cadence.

catalysts.label: Potential commercial approvals for partnered cell and gene therapies
catalysts.detail: Management cited positive FDA feedback to multiple biopharma partners, including Aspen Neuroscience's new RMAT designation, on potential BLA submissions, positioning ClearPoint for commercial drug-delivery revenue as partner therapies could reach the market by the end of 2027.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance lowered to $48-$52 million
catalysts.detail: Management cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $48.0-$52.0 million from the $52.0-$56.0 million range reiterated after Q1, as investment shifts from traditional sales expansion toward clinical case support, CAL facility readiness, and the new five-pillar $500 million long-term strategy.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro's Q2 2026 report (August 3, 2026) missed Wall Street estimates on both revenue ($10.9M vs. $12.7M consensus, still up 18% YoY) and adjusted EPS, and management cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $48-$52M from the $52-$56M range reiterated after Q1; shares fell roughly 15-18% to around $13, well off their 52-week high of $30, while cash dropped to $29.4M from $45.9M at the start of the year. Alongside the miss, management unveiled an ambitious long-term $500 million revenue target built around a new five-pillar "Essential. Everywhere." strategy centered on cell and gene therapy delivery to the brain. Near-term fundamentals are mixed: neurosurgery navigation/IRRAflow revenue is growing strongly and biopharma partners uniQure (Huntington's, BLA planned Q3 2026) and Aspen Neuroscience (RMAT designation for Parkinson's) are advancing toward possible 2027 commercial approvals, but the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment dipped and the tightening cash runway is a growing concern for investors.
